title: Enterprise Support: Effective compute unit price for missing-spend recognition
content:
Enterprise Support — Effective compute unit price for missing-spend recognition.

## Decision basis

For missing-spend recognition: Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use US East and on-demand standard configuration.

## Hypothetical case

For missing-spend recognition: A hypothetical selected compute unit price of USD 0.80 and applicable discount of 25 percent yield an effective price of USD 0.60 per vCPU-hour. The reduction acts once on the selected unit price.
